major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown, ideally overlapping with Colossus Smash/Warbreaker.

major_cooldowns.name: Colossus Smash
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to apply the Deep Wounds debuff and amplify subsequent damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Warbreaker
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown as an AoE alternative to Colossus Smash to amplify damage on all targets.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use during Avatar and Colossus Smash windows for massive AoE or single-target burst.

major_cooldowns.name: Sweeping Strikes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use when 2 or more targets are present to cleave single-target abilities.

defensives.name: Die by the Sword
defensives.usage_rule: Use to parry physical attacks and reduce all damage taken by 30%.

defensives.name: Spell Reflection
defensives.usage_rule: Use right before an incoming magic cast to reflect it and reduce magic damage taken.

defensives.name: Ignore Pain
defensives.usage_rule: Use as a rage dump for survivability when taking sustained damage.

rules.action: Always ensure Colossus Smash (or Warbreaker) is active before utilizing Bladestorm or dumping Rage during Avatar.
Use Execute, Mortal Strike, or Ignore Pain to prevent your Rage bar from sitting at 100%.
Cast Mortal Strike on cooldown to maintain the healing reduction and Deep Wounds DoT.

source_summary: Arms Warrior is a slow, methodical spec built around generating rage and spending it inside of precisely timed damage amplifier windows like Colossus Smash and Avatar.
